text.desktop: This is a practice board with two ready-made decks. Nothing you do here is saved. **Leave any time with ✕ or Esc.**
text.phone: This is a practice board with two ready-made decks. Nothing you do here is saved. **Leave any time with ✕.**

text.desktop: First, your opening hand. **Click the magnifier** in a card's top-right corner to look at it up close. **Click again** to put it back.
text.phone: First, your opening hand. **Press and hold a card** to see it large. **Tap anywhere on it** to put it back.

text.desktop: **Click a card you don't want**, say the most expensive one, to send it to the bottom. The curve and inkable readout under the hand show what you'd keep. Click it again to keep it.
text.phone: **Tap a card you don't want**, say the most expensive one, to send it to the bottom. The readout under the hand shows what you'd keep. Tap it again to keep it.

text.desktop: **Press Mulligan.** The key counts the cards you marked. They go to the bottom of your deck, you draw as many, and the Dojo shuffles the deck. With nothing marked, the key says Keep hand.
text.phone: **Tap Mulligan.** The key counts the cards you marked. They go to the bottom of your deck, you draw as many, and the Dojo shuffles the deck. With nothing marked, the key says Keep hand.

text.desktop: This is your new hand. The card you drew has a NEW pip. **Press Start turn** to play.
text.phone: This is your new hand. The card you drew has a NEW pip. **Tap Start turn** to play.

steps.text: The bottom half belongs to the player whose turn it is. It holds their hand, play area and inkwell. The other player's side is at the top.

text.desktop: Put a card in your inkwell. **Drag it from your hand onto the inkwell**, or **click it and press Add to the Inkwell**.
text.phone: Put a card in your inkwell. **Drag it from your hand onto the inkwell**, or **tap a card in your hand, then Ink**.

hint.phone: Only inkable cards can be inked. The others say **No ink**.

text.desktop: Now play a card. **Drag a 1-cost character onto your play area**, or **click it and press Play Card**.
text.phone: Now play a card. **Drag a 1-cost character onto your play area**, or **tap a 1-cost character, then Play**.

steps.hint: The cost is the number in the card's top-left corner.

steps.text: **Hover any card on the board** to read it here at full size, with its cost, strength, willpower, lore and text.
**Tap a card in your hand** to open its drawer. It shows the card at full size and what you can do with it. **Close it** when you've read it.

text.desktop: When you're done for this turn, **press End turn** or the Space bar.
text.phone: When you're done for this turn, **tap End turn**.

steps.text: Now you're Player 2. The board turns round, so their side is at the bottom. **Settle their opening hand, then ink one of their cards.**

text.desktop: Undo takes back the last thing you did. **Press Undo** now to take that ink back.
text.phone: Undo takes back the last thing you did. **Tap Undo** now to take that ink back.

steps.text: The Dojo keeps every turn you end as a node in the Multiverse. The mini map shows them here. **Press Multiverse or M** to open the whole tree.
The Dojo keeps every turn you end as a node in the Multiverse. **Tap this button** to open the whole tree.
